distinctive_features.feature: Shared real-time database across SIS, instruction, assessment, interventions, special services, and analytics
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Connected records reduce repeated entry and let districts coordinate student workflows across departments.
Districts can define risk indicators, intervention tiers, progress measures, and notifications around local processes.

distinctive_features.feature: Integrated IEP, 504, Medicaid, and special-education workflows
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Special-services teams can manage compliance, services, caseloads, and family communication alongside student records.

distinctive_features.feature: Assessment tools connect live results to standards analysis and instructional grouping
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Teachers and leaders can use assessment results to guide re-teaching, accommodations, and family feedback.
Dedicated apps support families, students, teachers, administrators, nurses, counselors, special educators, and kiosks.

distinctive_features.feature: Generative AI with user review and PII tokenization
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Staff can draft plans, comments, and content while retaining review responsibility and reducing exposure of identifying data.

distinctive_features.feature: OneRoster, Ed-Fi, SIF, and nearly 400 LTI integrations
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Standards-based connections support district data exchange, rostering, grade passback, and learning-tool integrations.

distinctive_features.feature: Online registration and lottery with weighted placement, waitlists, and audit trails
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Districts can manage multilingual enrollment and complex choice programs within connected workflows.

weaknesses.issue: Users report slowness, errors, inconvenience, and wasted time.
The new gradebook is described by reviewers as less friendly, with glitches and iPad printing limits.
Reviewers cite a steep learning curve and complex implementation.
ParentVUE and StudentVUE iOS apps receive low ratings, with complaints about missing features, duplicate notifications, freezing, and interface regressions.
Synergy LMS reviewers report low value-for-money ratings.
Pricing is quote-only, with no public price list or implementation-fee schedule.
Some desired functions are unavailable, according to reviewer feedback.
Public documentation does not describe a broad developer portal or open marketplace.

ai_features: Generates lesson plans, course content, assignments, tests, and study guides.
Drafts report-card comments, intervention plans, discipline and health notes, and special-education summaries.
Requires user review and tokenizes personally identifiable information before prompts are sent to ChatGPT.
pricing_model_summary: No public prices; district-specific quote and demonstration. Pricing may depend on students or school sites, selected modules, and implementation or support services.
biggest_strategic_gap: Broad district functionality is offset by reported usability, performance, and mobile-app concerns; pricing and implementation details are not publicly transparent.
